# Findings of TruffleHog that are test values, not credentials: the
# detector, FILE:LINE and the commit that added it, then the reason. Read by
# scripts/secrets-report.py --allow in .github/workflows/secrets.yml. Add an
# entry only for a value made for a test, never for a credential that was
# used: that one is revoked first (docs/development.md, "Checks").
